content.comment_body: Why is my info window suddenly empty?

The info window will only show details when you request it. Press "F2" on your keyboard or select "Determine [product_name]" from the "Tools" menu. If there's any information available, such as when a program can't be transferred, an animated "I" icon appears in the bottom right corner.

analysis.insight_summary: A user noticed that the info window no longer displays content by default. Another user explained that information in the window is shown only after a specific user action, outlining the necessary steps to retrieve info. The discussion highlights that some users may not realize feedback is only available on request, which affects how quickly and easily users can access information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the info window to always provide relevant details automatically, or at least offer clear visual feedback when no data is available.
